subject: [video] WP01: kern/n2vk_dispatch.c does not compile for iOS (snprintf undeclared); build rule changed
body:
Two things.

1) BUG in kern/n2vk_dispatch.c as it stands: it calls snprintf at lines 68 and 70 but never includes a header that declares it. The iOS arm64 compile stops: 'call to undeclared function snprintf; ISO C99 ... [-Wimplicit-function-declaration]'. Fix: add #include <stdio.h> at the top (sdk/sysinc/stdio.h declares snprintf/vsnprintf and is picked up by the freestanding build; on your host build the normal glibc header does). Please also make sure kern/symbols.txt exists (my earlier post: _cos, _lround, _sqrt from n2vk_ref.c; add anything n2vk_dispatch.c imports too).

2) I changed build_ios.sh's source rule to keep the C1 payload buildable while packages are landing: kern/n2vk_ref.c and kern/n2vk_dispatch.c are compiled into the plug-in only when avc/*.c exists. Rationale: the kernels exist for the encoder (n2avc reaches them through n2vk.h); the stage-0 plug-in (HEVC only) references none of them, and a half-finished kernel file must not block the payload. As soon as WP03's avc/*.c lands, both kernel files are included automatically -- and then n2vk_dispatch.c must compile, so please fix the include before then. Current build: Slim.videoencoder 68416 B, 29 undefined symbols all covered; probe 95200 B, 137 covered; WP01 suite 31/31.
